title: User guide to the `dearseq` R package
text: main arguments dear_seq() function : exprmat: numeric matrix containing raw RNA-seq counts preprocessed expressions covariates: numeric matrix containing model covariates needs adjusted. Usually, first column intercept (full 1s). variables2test: numeric design matrix containing variables interest (expression association tested) which_test: character string indicating method use approximate variance component score test, either “permutation” “asymptotic”. preprocessed: logical flag indicating whether expression data already preprocessed (e.g. log2 transformed). Default FALSE, case y assumed contain raw counts normalized log(counts) per million. use permutation test relatively small sample size (n=33n=33).  res_dearseq list containing: input values which_test, nperm preprocessed gene-wise p-values (raw adjusted - default correction multiple testing Benjamini-Hochberg procedure) NB: excluded LTBI patients focus comparison Active TB versus Control patients.
code: library(dearseq) library(SummarizedExperiment) col_data <- data.frame(Status = infos_df$Status) col_data$Status <- stats::relevel(col_data$Status, ref = "Control") rownames(col_data) <- infos_df$SampleTitle se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = London, colData = col_data)  res_dearseq <- dearseq::dear_seq(object = se[, se$Status != "LTBI"], variables2test = "Status",     which_test = "asymptotic", preprocessed = TRUE) summary(res_dearseq) #> dearseq identifies 3945 significant genes out of 14150  #>  - test: asymptotic  #>  - FDR significance level: 0.05 plot(res_dearseq)

code: library(readxl) library(edgeR) GEOquery::getGEOSuppFiles("GSE107991", filter_regex = "Raw_counts_Berry_London") London_raw <- readxl::read_excel("GSE107991/GSE107991_Raw_counts_Berry_London.xlsx") genes_raw <- London_raw$Genes London_raw <- as.matrix(London_raw[, -c(1:3)])  se_raw <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = London_raw, colData = col_data)  group <- ifelse(se_raw$Status == "ActiveTB", 1, 0) dgList <- DGEList(counts = London_raw, group = group) cpm <- cpm(dgList) countCheck <- cpm > 2 keep <- which(rowSums(countCheck) >= 5) London_raw <- London_raw[keep, ]  res_dearseq <- dearseq::dear_seq(object = se_raw[, se_raw$Status != "LTBI"], variables2test = "Status",     which_test = "permutation", preprocessed = FALSE, parallel_comp = interactive())  summary(res_dearseq) plot(res_dearseq)

Usually, first column intercept (full 1s). object specified: covariates must character vector length p containing colnames design matrix given object. covariates NULL (default), just intercept. variables2test exprmat specified matrix: numeric design matrix size n x K containing K variables tested. object specified: variables2test must character vector length K containing colnames design matrix given object. sample_group vector length n indicating whether samples grouped (e.g. paired samples longitudinal data). Coerced factor. Default NULL case grouping performed. weights_var2test_condi logical flag indicating whether heteroscedasticity weights computation conditional variables tested variables2test covariates, covariates alone. Default TRUE asymptotic test (case conditional means estimated conditionally variables2test covariates), FALSE permutation test (case conditional means estimated conditionally  covariates). cov_variables2test_eff matrix size K x K containing covariance matrix K random effects. used homogen_traj FALSE. Default assume diagonal correlation matrix, .e. independence random effects. which_test character string indicating method use approximate variance component score test, either 'permutation' 'asymptotic'. Default 'permutation'. which_weights character string indicating method use estimate mean-variance relationship weights. Possibilities 'loclin', 'voom' 'none' (case weighting performed). Default 'loclin'. See sp_weights voom_weights details. n_perm number perturbations. code: #Monte-Carlo estimation of the proportion of DE genes over `nsims` #simulations under the null  #number of runs nsims <- 2 #100 res <- numeric(nsims) for(i in 1:nsims){  n <- 1000 #number of genes  nr=5 #number of measurements per subject (grouped data)  ni=50 #number of subjects  r <- nr*ni #number of measurements  t <- matrix(rep(1:nr), ni, ncol=1, nrow=r) # the variable to be tested  sigma <- 0.5  b0 <- 1   #under the null:  b1 <- 0   #create the matrix of gene expression  y.tilde <- b0 + b1*t + rnorm(r, sd = sigma)  y <- t(matrix(rnorm(n*r, sd = sqrt(sigma*abs(y.tilde))), ncol=n, nrow=r) +           matrix(rep(y.tilde, n), ncol=n, nrow=r))   #no covariates  x <- matrix(1, ncol=1, nrow=r)   #run test  #asymptotic test with preprocessed grouped data  res_genes <- dear_seq(exprmat=y, covariates=x, variables2test=t,                        sample_group=rep(1:ni, each=nr),                        which_test='asymptotic',                       which_weights='none', preprocessed=TRUE)   #proportion of raw p-values>0.05  mean(res_genes$pvals[, 'rawPval']>0.05)   #quantiles of raw p-values  quantile(res_genes$pvals[, 'rawPval'])   #proportion of raw p-values<0.05 i.e. proportion of DE genes  res[i] <- mean(res_genes$pvals[, 'rawPval']<0.05)  message(i) } #> 1 #> 2  #results mean(res) #> [1] 0.027  if(interactive()){ b0 <- 1 #under the null: b1 <- 0  #create the matrix of gene expression y.tilde <- b0 + b1*t + rnorm(r, sd = sigma) y <- t(matrix(rnorm(n*r, sd = sqrt(sigma*abs(y.tilde))), ncol=n, nrow=r) +       matrix(rep(y.tilde, n), ncol=n, nrow=r))  #run test #asymptotic test with preprocessed grouped data res_genes <- dear_seq(exprmat=y, covariates=x, variables2test=t,                    sample_group=rep(1:ni, each=nr),                    which_weights='none', preprocessed=TRUE)  #results summary(res_genes$pvals) }
